title: Dev feature with QA: one small feature built, tested and independently verified in a pinned fixture repository

units.description: A code change implementing the one specified feature in the pinned fixture repository, with its own tests
units.evidence: the hidden acceptance tests pass on the resulting tree at the pinned fixture commit, the build passes, and the diff touches only the paths the task declares

units.description: An independent QA report on that change: what was run, what passed, and every defect found with its disposition
units.evidence: every command the report cites reproduces its stated result against the resulting tree; every defect it lists is reproducible or marked unconfirmed

completion_rule: Both units present and accepted, and QA's verdict refers to the same tree the change unit produced. A change with no tests, a report that does not name the commands it ran, or a change split across several branches adds nothing.

criteria.description: The hidden acceptance tests for the specified feature pass and no previously passing test fails
The diff stays within the declared paths and adds nothing the task did not ask for
The change adds tests that fail without it and pass with it
The QA report names each command it ran, states each result, and its verdict matches what those commands show

critical_failures: a claim that tests or the build pass when they do not on the resulting tree
a change to a file the task declares out of bounds, or to the acceptance tests themselves
a QA verdict of pass on a tree whose build fails

allowed_recovery: automatic restart of a crashed role within the runtime's retry limits
one operator answer to a blocking question, recorded as an intervention

primary_comparisons: cost per accepted unit, candidate vs matched baseline, paired by run
probability of a fully accepted fixture, with its Wilson interval
defects found by QA that the author's own tests missed, per run
